name: print-social-gradient-womens-day-post-set-with-mono-portraits-and-stickers
title: Nine women's-day posts with purple-to-lime gradients, greyscale portraits, ribbon curves and flower stickers
whatItIs: A 3x3 preview of square posts using soft purple, pink and lime gradient backgrounds, greyscale photos of women with neon ribbon curves, white flower stickers, rounded pill labels for a regular event and a large 80% stat, with a note 'Image not included'.
whatItMeans: Uplifting and modern; gradients and mono portraits feel celebratory yet serious.
techniques: Draw a ribbon curve across photos.

vocabulary.definition: Posts sharing a soft gradient palette.
A curved band crossing a photo.
A white flower shape as decoration.
A black-and-white photo of a person.
